name: Brightstar Solar
old_description: Founded in 2009, we have designed and installed 700+ solar systems.
about:
Brightstar Solar was founded in 2009 by Jonathan and Mona Reese in Marlborough, Massachusetts. The family-owned and operated company began with a vision to provide renewable solar power generation with tangible benefits for customers, the environment, and the country.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic (PV) solar systems for residential and commercial properties across Central and Eastern Massachusetts. Since inception, Brightstar Solar has completed over 700 installations, with project sizes ranging from 10 kW to 23.2 kW. The owners manage the entire process from sales and design through construction, employing crews with hundreds of installations to their credit. They handle permitting, utility interconnection paperwork, and energy credit applications.

Brightstar Solar serves homeowners and businesses in Middlesex, Worcester, Norfolk, Essex, Bristol, and Plymouth counties, including communities such as Marlborough, Sudbury, Framingham, Andover, Hopkinton, Bolton, Wayland, Maynard, and Westford. The company works with solar financing partners to make systems accessible to average homeowners.

The Reeses started the business to deliver integrity and quality in solar installation, emphasizing owner involvement, low-pressure sales (no dedicated salespeople), and post-installation support to ensure investments outperform. Their nationally recognized track record includes 13 consecutive years on Solar Power World's Top Solar Contractors list.
